---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a concrete electronics or IoT workflow
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Field problem

What device/workflow is blocked today, and who encounters it?

## Proposed workflow

Describe the inputs, explicit user actions, visible result, saved/exported evidence, and stop/recovery path.

## Hardware and safety

List pins/bus, voltage levels, required external protection, target hardware, and likely conflicts with existing tools.

## Evidence of demand

Name representative devices or sessions. Shared profile/recipe abstractions require three materially different proven devices under `ROADMAP.md`.

## Scope boundaries

What should remain out of scope? Can an existing tool, standard file, or ESP-IDF feature already solve the problem?
